title: Disjoint Sumsets Construction
exact_target: Can a nearly quadratic-size abelian group support arbitrarily many nearly quadratic-size injective addition pairs whose matched sums avoid every mismatched sum?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 167 (GREEN-079). CC BY 4.0.

Henry Cohn, Robert Kleinberg, Balázs Szegedy and Christopher Umans, \emph{Group-theoretic algorithms for matrix multiplication}, FOCS 2005, 379--388; arXiv:math/0511460v1, §4, Definition 4.1 and Conjecture 4.7. Replacing each source subset $B_i$ by its negative converts the difference-set convention into the displayed sum-set convention.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author list, Problem 36 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
